{{RV|type=function

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.00

|gr1= Sides

|descr= Returns colour of define side either as [[Array]] in format RGBA or the name of the colour as [[String]]

|s1= [side, returnString] call [[BIS_fnc_sideColor]]

|p1= side: [[Side]]

|p2= returnString: [[Boolean]] - (Optional, default [[false]]) wanted output:
* [[false]]: [R, G ,B, A]
* [[true]]: "ColourName"

|r1= or [[String]] or [[Array]] format [[Color|Color (RGBA)]]

|x1= <sqf>[blufor, false] call BIS_fnc_sideColor; // returns [0,0.3,0.6,1]</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>[blufor, true] call BIS_fnc_sideColor; // returns "ColorWEST"</sqf>

|seealso= [[side]] [[Arma 3: CfgMarkerColors]]
}}
